entities.summary:
The 2021 Taliban offensive was a pivotal military campaign led by the Taliban in Afghanistan, resulting in the collapse of the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan. 

The offensive, which began in April 2021, was marked by a rapid series of victories for the Taliban, who seized key cities and provinces across the country. 

The fall of Kabul on August 15, 2021, marked the end of the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan and the beginning of a new era of Taliban rule. 

The consequences of the offensive were far-reaching, with many Afghans fleeing the country in fear of persecution, and the international community struggling to respond to the humanitarian crisis. 

As Taliban fighters raised their flag over the presidential palace, the world watched in horror as a decades-long effort to build a democratic Afghanistan came crashing down. 

The 2021 Taliban offensive marked the end of an era and the beginning of a new chapter in the complex and often fraught history of Afghanistan.
